01.job: Pick a voice that fits the use case
01.situation: Sam is setting up an agent and the voice catalog has hundreds of voices.
01.want: pick a voice that fits the use case, or clone one
01.so: Sam does not audition the whole catalog and the agent sounds right for its callers

02.job: Make the agent interrupt, wait and listen like a person
02.situation: Callers talk over the agent or wait too long through silences.
02.want: tune when the agent starts, stops and backchannels
02.so: the conversation feels like talking to a person

03.job: Be understood in the caller's language, accent and jargon
03.situation: Callers speak several languages and use product jargon, and a speech vendor can fail mid-call.
03.want: tune recognition, add dictionaries and set a fallback transcriber
03.so: callers are understood even when a vendor fails

04.job: Make the first seconds and the pauses feel natural and compliant
04.situation: The agent's opening, its silences while tools run and the required disclaimer decide the first impression.
04.want: shape the greeting, the fillers and the disclaimer
04.so: callers stay on the line and the call meets the compliance bar

05.job: Control what happens on idle, silence, voicemail and keypad input
05.situation: Calls hit silence, voicemail, a maximum duration or an IVR.
05.want: set a rule for each of those moments
05.so: every call ends the way the team intends

06.job: Shape how the agent sounds, not just what it says
06.situation: The agent's words are right but the delivery is flat.
06.want: set tone, expression, pronunciation and ambience
06.so: the agent sounds like the brand

07.job: Keep the models running across vendors and regions
07.situation: A model vendor or a region degrades during live calls.
07.want: set provider fallbacks and see vendor parity
07.so: calls keep going without Sam watching

08.job: Change a live agent safely and undo the change
08.situation: An agent is live and Sam needs to ship a change.
08.want: version the agent, release to an environment, roll back and A/B test
08.so: a bad change never reaches every caller

09.job: Get a working agent in minutes
09.situation: Sam starts from scratch or moves from Vapi or Retell.
09.want: start from defaults, a template or an import
09.so: the first working agent takes minutes, not a day

10.job: Replay exactly what happened on a call
10.situation: A caller reports a problem and Sam has only the session id.
10.want: hear the audio and read the aligned transcript and provider payloads

11.job: Know whose fault a failed or slow call was
11.situation: A call failed or lagged, and the carrier, the network and the models are all suspects.
11.want: see SIP errors, signaling ladders and latency by stage
11.so: Sam blames the right party and fixes the right thing

12.job: Watch live calls and step in when one goes wrong
12.situation: Calls are happening now and one is going badly.
12.want: watch live calls, nudge quality, take over or end a call
12.so: a bad call is cut short before it costs a customer

13.job: See agent health without asking an engineer
13.situation: Sam needs numbers for the pilot and has no analyst.
13.so: Sam reports agent health and hears about trouble first

14.job: Prove an agent is good before and after shipping
14.situation: The team asks whether the agent is good enough to ship, or better after a change.
14.want: run evals in Studio and CI and score production calls
14.so: quality is proven with numbers, not opinions

15.job: Stress-test an agent without real callers
15.situation: Sam wants to break the agent before customers do.
15.want: run and compare simulated calls at scale, with humans joining
15.so: failures show up in a simulation first

16.job: Buy a number and take a call without leaving Studio
16.situation: Sam has an agent and no number.
16.want: buy and assign a number inside Studio

17.job: Connect the team's own carrier once
17.situation: The team has a carrier contract and a SIP trunk.
17.want: connect the trunk once, with the right gateway location
17.so: Sam never touches the trunk again

18.job: Put one agent on WhatsApp, SMS, web and text
18.situation: Customers reach the team on more than the phone.
18.want: run the same agent on WhatsApp, SMS, a browser widget and text

19.job: Let the agent act on other systems without code
19.situation: The agent must look things up and act in other systems.
19.want: add tools and connectors without writing code
19.so: the agent acts, not just talks

20.job: Keep the agent's knowledge current from real sources
20.situation: The answers live on sites and in documents that change.
20.want: crawl sources, including authenticated ones, on a schedule
20.so: the agent answers from current facts

21.job: Greet callers with context and write back what happened
21.situation: Callers are known customers in the CRM.
21.want: give the agent CRM context and let the agent write back
21.so: callers feel known and the CRM stays current

22.job: Understand the bill and buy more capacity
22.situation: Usage grows and the team asks what costs what.
22.want: see usage and credits by model and raise concurrency
22.so: Sam controls spend and capacity without a ticket

23.job: Hand a caller to the right human or agent, with context
23.situation: The agent reaches the limit of what the agent should handle.
23.want: route by skill or condition and transfer with a summary

24.job: Meet the compliance bar without filing a ticket
24.situation: Legal sets retention and PII rules for call artifacts.
24.want: set retention, redaction and storage policies
24.so: the team passes review without engineering work

25.job: Build by API and still see everything in the UI
25.situation: The team builds agents from code.
25.want: see API-created agents, manage webhooks and use a CLI
25.so: code and Console show the same truth

26.job: Sign in once for Console and Studio
26.situation: Sam signs in twice for two apps.

27.situation: Sam opens Studio on a laptop, a tablet and a phone.
27.want: every screen to work at every size

28.situation: A developer starts a front end for the agent.
28.want: a UI kit, docs help and benchmarks
28.so: the front end ships in days
